nodes.label: System Architecture
nodes.rationale: High-level overview of single Next.js app serving platform super-admin, hotel staff dashboard, and guestbooking via middleware routing, backed by Supabase and Clerk.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Architecture
nodes.rationale: Shared database with row-level security (RLS) isolation based on Clerk Organizations, JWT custom claims, and storage paths.

nodes.label: Payment System (Paystack)
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant payment routing via Paystack subaccounts scoped by paystack_subaccount_code.
